+    def _get_packages_with_licenses_concurrent(self, package_list: List[Tuple[str, str]], cmd: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]:
+        """Get package information with licenses using concurrent processing."""
+        packages = []
+        
+        # Separate cached and uncached packages
+        cached_packages = []
+        uncached_packages = []
+        
+        for package_name, version in package_list:
+            cached_licenses = self.cache.get("dnf", package_name, version)
+            if cached_licenses is not None:
+                cached_packages.append({
+                    "name": package_name,
+                    "display_name": package_name,
+                    "version": version,
+                    "manager": "dnf",
+                    "licenses": cached_licenses
+                })
+            else:
+                uncached_packages.append((package_name, version))
+        
+        packages.extend(cached_packages)
+        
+        # Process uncached packages concurrently
+        if uncached_packages:
+            max_workers = min(16, len(uncached_packages))  # Limit concurrent processes
+            
+            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
+                # Submit all license fetch tasks

+                    executor.submit(self._get_dnf_license_single, pkg_name, version, cmd): (pkg_name, version)
+                    for pkg_name, version in uncached_packages
+                }
+                
+                # Collect results as they complete

+                    package_name, version = future_to_package[future]

+                        licenses = future.result()

+

+                            "name": package_name,
+                            "display_name": package_name,
+                            "version": version,
+                            "manager": "dnf",
+                            "licenses": licenses
+                        })

+                            "display_name": package_name,

+                            "licenses": ["unknown"]
+                        })

+        return packages
